judgment_methodology.method: Fowler's code-smell catalog to identify what actually warrants refactoring versus stylistic preference

planning_methodology.method: Strangler Fig incremental-replacement plan for legacy surfaces with no test coverage

deliverable_form.method: Named refactoring from Fowler's catalog applied with before/after diff citing the catalog entry

feedback_methodology.method: Characterization-test-first review: does a change to untested legacy code add a characterization test before altering behavior
feedback_methodology.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

review_methodology.method: Seam identification review: confirm the refactor introduces or uses a seam rather than editing untestable code directly
review_methodology.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

degree_level_knowledge.concept: Fowler's refactoring catalog and code smells

degree_level_knowledge.source: Feathers, Working Effectively with Legacy Code (Prentice Hall 2004)

reference_resolution.rule: refactoring_name must resolve to an actual entry in Fowler's catalog — no invented refactoring names (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: verdict is recomputed by re-running the test suite after mechanics is applied, never a standalone asserted field.
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a code smell is flagged on the branch AND no refactoring-legacy record exists yet for that smell
